title: Convert to No Charge is disabled while a deposit is on the work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, with a deposit taken.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Hover over "Convert to No Charge".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • "Convert to No Charge" shows disabled.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "Reverse the deposit first".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-N4: “If the work order has a deposit, "Convert to No Charge" is disabled with the tooltip "Reverse the deposit first", as the Change Customer button on the customer card is today.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Convert to No Charge with a deposit | "Reverse the deposit first" | Tooltip on the disabled menu action”
